# Spartacus Martial Arts Academy

> Spartacus Martial Arts Academy is a martial arts and sports psychology training
> academy based in Perambur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. It is founded and led by
> Kishore Kumar — a Wushu National Medalist, Kung Fu Black Belt, certified Sports
> Psychologist, Wushu Coach and State-level Wushu Judge. The academy teaches Wushu,
> Kung Fu, Karate, Judo, Kick Boxing, Boxing and self-defense, and combines physical
> martial arts training with sports psychology to build discipline, confidence and
> performance under pressure. Training is available both in person in Chennai and
> online.

## Who runs it

Kishore Kumar is the founder and head coach. His credentials:

- Wushu National Medalist (competed and medalled at national level)
- Kung Fu Black Belt
- Certified Sports Psychologist
- Wushu Coach
- State-level Wushu Judge

This combination — a competing national medalist who is also a certified sports
psychologist and an official judge — is what distinguishes Spartacus from other
martial arts academies in Chennai. Training is delivered by Kishore Kumar directly.

## Where it operates

Base location: Perambur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

Primary service areas (North and Central Chennai): Perambur, Vyasarpadi,
Ayanavaram, Kolathur, Villivakkam, Purasaiwakkam, Kilpauk, Anna Nagar, Royapuram,
Otteri, Sembiam, Moolakadai, Madhavaram — and the wider Chennai metro area.

Online sports psychology and mindset coaching is available beyond Chennai.

## What it teaches

Martial arts programmes:
- Wushu (the founder's competitive specialty)
- Kung Fu
- Karate
- Judo
- Kick Boxing
- Boxing
- Self-defense training
- Kids martial arts

Sports psychology and mindset programmes:
- Athlete mindset and mental conditioning
- Performance under pressure
- Competition preparation

The academy's named framework is the Warrior Mind Method, built on five pillars:
Focus, Fire, Flow, Forge and Fight.

## Who it is for

- Parents looking for martial arts classes for their children in Chennai
- Competitive athletes wanting a mental-performance edge
- Adults training for fitness, discipline and self-defense
- Women seeking practical self-defense training
- Schools, colleges and organisations booking martial arts or mindset workshops

Students range from complete beginners and children through to competing athletes.
Beginners are explicitly welcome; no prior experience is required.
